definition.selection: Four largest original net losses among PH5 trades with neither gap_exposed nor context_partial; ties by id. Outcome-selected diagnostic controls, not a prospective trading filter.
definition.observation: Original entry through original exit minute, or original Nov15 05:16 EST cutoff. Exit-minute OHLC is separately labeled and never used to anticipate the exit.
definition.checkpoint: First complete post-entry 5m close below original HL, and first complete 15m close below it. Market completion and actual receipt are separate.
